lore: His stove bursts when he falls. Keep tender plants away from him.
mechanism: Death blast: a Hungry Ghost with 70 HP and a 0.7 m/s walk. When killed by damage (not by shovel) the stove spills coals once: every plant in the Plants group within blast_radius (XZ) of him, uneatable ground traps included, takes blast_damage through its own take_damage. Radius squared is precomputed in _apply_balance; the group walk happens only inside _die. All march/seek/eat/siege AI, health bar and materials inherited.
name: Cao Lau Cook
